# Returns and Exceptions

> Current as of 2026-10-10. The reusable check-in steps live in the [Volunteer Handbook](../../handbook/check-in/README.md).

## Normal return

Match the tool identifier to the slip, inspect for missing parts, record the return time, and place the tool in its bin. The [check-in diagram](../../handbook/check-in/check-in-flow.svg) is a quick reference, not a replacement for the slip or source notice.

## Damaged or incomplete tool

Record what the volunteer observed. Put the tool aside for maintenance review rather than making up a fee. The [3 October exceptions meeting](../meetings/2026-10-03-exceptions.md) did not authorize a charge or a new desk rule.

## Open questions

Three borrowers asked about returning tools at another branch during the pilot. No transfer was processed and the [posted notice](../sources/README.md) is silent. [A-06](../actions.md#open-actions) is assigned to the policy owner; until then, volunteers should offer the original desk as the confirmed return location.

A separate [inbox question](../../inbox.md) asks whether a missing accessory is first recorded on the slip or the maintenance card. This is a documentation gap, not permission to discard evidence.
